missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Дядя' is a masculine noun despite its -я ending, and stays nominative as the subject. 'Мой' is the masculine possessive, and 'в Москве' is prepositional of location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Дядю' is the accusative of the animate 'дядя' as the object of 'видел'. The -я noun takes the -ю accusative ending.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'У дяди' uses the genitive 'дяди' after 'у' to show whose car it is. The -я ending becomes -и in the genitive.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'нет'. 'Дяди' is the genitive required by 'нет' to express absence, the same form as the possessive genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Дяде' is the dative of 'дядя', the recipient of the letter. 'Письмо' is the accusative direct object of 'написал'.

missions.phrase: Мы едем в гости к дяде.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after 'к'. 'К дяде' uses the dative 'дяде' after 'к' to show the destination of a visit. A natural pattern for going to someone's place.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'гордиться'. 'Дядей' is the instrumental of 'дядя', required by 'гордиться'. The soft -я ending gives the -ей instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О дяде' uses the prepositional 'дяде' after 'о' to name the topic. 'Моём' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Дяди' is the nominative plural of 'дядя', the subject of 'приехали'. 'Из деревни' is the genitive of origin.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Дядей' is the accusative plural of the animate 'дядя', matching the genitive plural form. 'Своих' agrees in the animate plural.
